chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. 'Isa narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Muqatil b. Sulayman from Abi 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:

I am the master of the prophets, and my deputy is the master of the deputies, and his deputies are the masters of the deputies. Verily, Adam (peace be upon him) asked Allah the Mighty and Majestic to give him a righteous deputy. So Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed to him: 'Verily I ennobled the prophets with prophethood, then I chose My creation, and I made the best of them the deputies.'

Then Allah the Mighty and Majestic revealed to him: 'O Adam, depute Sheeth.' So Adam deputed Sheeth -- and he is Habatullah (the Gift of God) b. Adam. Sheeth deputed his son Shaban, who is the son of Nazla, the houri that Allah bestowed unto Adam from Paradise; so he married her to his son Sheeth. Shaban deputed Mujallath. Mujallath deputed Mahuq. Mahuq deputed Ghathmisha. Ghathmisha deputed Ekhnokh -- and he is Idris the Prophet (peace be upon him). Idris deputed Nahur. Nahur gave it to Nuh the Prophet (peace be upon him). Nuh deputed Sam. Sam deputed 'Athamir. 'Athamir deputed Bar'ithasha. Bar'ithasha deputed Yafith. Yafith deputed Barra. Barra deputed Jafsiyya. Jafsiyya deputed 'Imran. 'Imran gave it to Ibrahim the Friend of the Merciful (peace be upon him).

Ibrahim deputed his son Isma'il. Isma'il deputed Ishaq. Ishaq deputed Ya'qub. Ya'qub deputed Yusuf. Yusuf deputed Buthriya'. Buthriya' deputed Shu'ayb (peace be upon him). Shu'ayb gave it to Musa b. 'Imran (peace be upon him). Musa b. 'Imran (peace be upon him) deputed Yusha' b. Nun. Yusha' b. Nun deputed Dawud (peace be upon him). Dawud (peace be upon him) deputed Sulayman (peace be upon him). Sulayman (peace be upon him) deputed Asif b. Barkhiyya. Asif b. Barkhiyya deputed Zakariyya (peace be upon him). Zakariyya (peace be upon him) gave it to 'Isa b. Maryam (peace be upon him). 'Isa deputed Sham'un b. Hammun al-Safa. Sham'un deputed Yahya b. Zakariyya. Yahya b. Zakariyya deputed Mundhir. Mundhir deputed Sulayma. Sulayma deputed Burda.

Then the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: Burda gave it to me, and I give it to you, O 'Ali. You will give it to your deputy, and your deputy will give it to your deputies from your progeny, one after another, until it is given to the best of the people of the Earth after you. The Nation will surely disbelieve in you, and they will surely dispute over you severely. The steadfast upon you is like one established with me, while the estranged from you is in the Fire -- and the Fire is the lodging of the disbelievers.

key_terms.الأوصياء: The Deputies -- the divinely appointed successors of the prophets, forming an unbroken chain from Adam to 'Ali and his descendants
key_terms.الثابت: The steadfast one -- whoever holds firm to 'Ali's authority is likened to being with the Prophet himself
key_terms.النجيب: The best of the people of the Earth -- referring to the final Imam from 'Ali's descendants
key_terms.خليل الرحمن: The Friend of the Merciful -- the title of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham)
key_terms.هبة الله: The Gift of God -- an epithet of Sheeth (Seth), the first deputy

ai.seo_question: What is the complete chain of divinely appointed deputies (awsiya') from Prophet Adam to Prophet Muhammad according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (S) declares himself the master of prophets and his deputy ('Ali) the master of deputies. He then traces the unbroken chain of divinely appointed deputies (awsiya') from Adam to himself. God revealed to Adam that He ennobled the prophets with prophethood and chose the best of His creation as deputies, commanding Adam to depute Sheeth (Hibatullah). From Sheeth, the chain passed through Shaban, Mujallath, Mahuq, Ghathmisha, Idris (Ekhnokh), Nahur, Nuh, Sam, 'Athamir, Bar'ithasha, Yafith, Barra, Jafsiyya, 'Imran, Ibrahim (the Friend of the Merciful), Isma'il, Ishaq, Ya'qub, Yusuf, Buthriya', Shu'ayb, Musa b. 'Imran, Yusha' b. Nun, Dawud, Sulayman, Asif b. Barkhiyya, Zakariyya, 'Isa b. Maryam, Sham'un b. Hammun al-Safa, Yahya b. Zakariyya, Mundhir, Sulayma, and Burda. The Prophet concludes by telling 'Ali that Burda gave it to him, and he gives it to 'Ali, who will pass it through his descendants one after another until the best of the people of the Earth. He warns that the Nation will deny 'Ali and dispute severely over him, but the steadfast upon 'Ali is like one established with the Prophet, while the deviant is in the Fire.
